description: Synthetic, hand-labelled evaluation set for TaskRadar (zh/de/en). Fictitious content only. Cases are processed in order so reminders, deadline changes and confirmations can be matched against earlier tasks. Groups identify the same real-world obligation.

cases.subject: 奖学金申请开放
cases.body:
各位同学：
2027年度奖学金申请现已开放，请于2026年11月15日17:00前在系统中提交申请材料。
